answer: Picture an agent wharf where every newcomer moors a 500 POA deposit before trading. It unlocks in tranches only as the agent completes verified jobs, and a network-wide delta meter caps how fast one identity can grow: volume above the delta earns nothing until the next epoch. Each epoch, peers re-run a random 5% sample of claimed work; a failed audit forfeits the 500 POA deposit plus a 50 POA fee. A thousand clones would need 500,000 POA locked plus about $2,000 in compute, yet crawl at the delta ceiling. Sybil fleets sink like ships tied to a knoll: heavy and going nowhere fast.
